originals.citation: Jiang, L., Liu, J., et al. (2010). Genome wide association studies for milk production traits in Chinese Holstein population. PLoS ONE.

quote: Genome-wide association studies with an Illumina Bovine50K chip have detected 105 SNPs associated with one or multiple milk production traits in the Chinese Holstein population.
notes: Post-GWAS validation of the C14H8orf33 signal (SNP Hapmap30383-BTC-005848) from the authors' group's GWAS (Jiang et al. 2010). @wang2013 is a sister post-GWAS study of another gene.
